_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 56: 9-14 March 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are persuaded that what he promised he is able to perform, asks what he is telling them to do as the church in these end times, cites Mary saying to do whatever he tells you, and says not to sit back waiting.
mentions.quote: Whatever he tells you to do, do it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they may have to say they choose to follow Jesus and tell their friends to come find them when they are ready to make a choice, that they cannot go back to what they were doing, and that God will bring them new friends.
mentions.quote: I'm going to find some new friends. And God will bring you some new friends
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on leaving the old company
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He shows the earthquakes that have happened just in the month of March and asks them to look at where they all were, and reads that a very strong magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck near Naples, Italy shortly after midnight on March 10th 2026, the strongest to hit that part of Italy in more than 63 years.
mentions.quote: a magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck near Naples, Italy on March 10th, 2026
mentions.falsify_match: A real and dated event offered as fulfilment of the Italy material. Whether the prior claims say Naples, and say what would happen there, is checkable in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: The prior claims do not match it.

mentions.claim_text: He asks to watch the video again and it replays the Naples earthquake report, noting the last quake of equal or greater strength in that part of Italy.
mentions.quote: Can we watch that video again?
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: the same report played twice.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He refers to people offering to be security for him, ex-military and special forces and all kinds, says he appreciates the offer and they will look it over, and that he and his wife will pray about it if he has a peace.
mentions.quote: you want to be security for me. you have ex-military, your special forces
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: an offer received and being considered.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the shockwave was so big and they made it look like it was an accident, that he saw this event taking place, wonders whether it is in the book, and confirms with someone whether they were there that night when he saw a major event.
mentions.quote: the shockwave was so big and they made it look like it was an accident
mentions.falsify_match: A large explosion officially attributed to an accident.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Made to look like an accident means an official accident finding would confirm rather than disconfirm it.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told it is a significant day and a significant timeframe for a major terrorist attack, says he asked the Lord when it is, and that he saw the month of October highlighted and the month of September highlighted but did not know which.
mentions.quote: It's a significant time frame for a major terrorist attack
mentions.falsify_match: A major terrorist attack in September or October 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither month produces one. He says outright he does not know which of the two.

mentions.claim_text: He says 9/11 falls on a Jewish festival and one of their holy days this year, that the Lord circled and bolded it to him, and that the Fourth of July was also emboldened, mentioning Easter.
mentions.quote: the Lord circled this to me and he bolded it
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on 11 September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes quietly. Three dates are emboldened here, which widens rather than narrows the target.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are close to them and they listen and watch, that he is excited they at least listen and know what is coming, and mentions gas lines over eight dollars a gallon nationwide and that he is trying to help with that.
mentions.quote: Gas lines over $8 a gallon nationwide
mentions.falsify_match: National average petrol prices above eight dollars a gallon, which is published weekly.
mentions.falsify_miss: They stay below. One of the few claims in the corpus with a hard number against a public series.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the month of April, that it is bold to him concerning this area.
mentions.quote: I see the month of April. It's bold to me concerning this area
mentions.falsify_match: Something notable in April in the region under discussion.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet April. Second April sighting with nothing but emphasis attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is all he sees over the last weeks of March, an escalation of things in this area, repeated, and that he sees boats on fire and major container ships on fire, with fire everywhere and boats leaking.
mentions.quote: I see major container ships on fire. There's fire everywhere
mentions.falsify_match: Container ships burning, which would be widely reported.
mentions.falsify_miss: None in that window. Specific and visible if it happens, and the window is short.

mentions.claim_text: He says people will think they are retiring from their worldly job, but that God says they may be retiring from that while he has a heavenly job for them, and answers the objection about a severance package.
mentions.quote: I got a heavenly job for you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord drawing the bride to his side, saying many people are asleep and that he is going to shake all tribes and all tongues and every denomination, and that it is not only the charismatics who are the bride.
mentions.quote: I'm going to shake all tribes and all tongues, every denomination
mentions.falsify_match: Upheaval across denominations.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Widening the target to every denomination makes a match easier, not harder.

mentions.claim_text: He says he hears great distractions concerning the midterms, repeated, and that he sees and is praying over the month of October, which he sees very bold, praying over midterm distractions, and that he sees the month of September.
mentions.quote: I see the month of October very bold. Praying over midterm distractions
mentions.falsify_match: A major diverting event in the run-up to the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Distraction cannot fail in either direction, and the same two months carry the terrorist attack claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says God told him he is bringing justice, that even 2026 will be a time of divine justice, that this is part of 1 Corinthians 5:5, and that what was done in secret will be brought to the surface openly.
mentions.quote: 2026 will be a time of divine justice
mentions.falsify_match: Hidden things surfacing publicly during 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Something is exposed every year, so the claim is satisfied by ordinary news.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is so much news and so much brought to them that he asks what they believe and do not believe, that they have to filter it and go with what they are praying over, and mentions the president declaring something.
mentions.quote: you have to really just kind of filter it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is a rare acknowledgement that the news feeding these sessions needs filtering.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says what they are praying on right now is Iranian, that they have infiltrated the nation and he saw these men, and that the Lord said to pray over the high schools and college campuses, plead the blood, anoint the children with oil and pray over the churches.
mentions.quote: They have infiltrated your nation. And I saw these men
mentions.falsify_match: An Iranian-linked plot uncovered in the United States, with schools or campuses as targets.
mentions.falsify_miss: None uncovered. Naming Iran and naming schools is more specific than the earlier hidden-cells material.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is the same spot the Lord showed him, that he said it was right off the water, that he told Brennan it was wild, and that it is the same area right there.
mentions.quote: the same spot the Lord showed me. I said it's right off the water
mentions.falsify_match: A location match between an earlier sighting and a news event, which the earlier telling in this corpus would settle.
mentions.falsify_miss: The earlier telling does not name that area. What the event is is not stated in the passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was the Damascus area and all that point of Israel, that he saw it used on the Israeli people and it was an attack worse than October the 7th of four years ago, that this was an attack plan, and that they said it is time.
mentions.quote: I saw it was used on the Israeli people
mentions.falsify_match: A biological attack on Israel originating near Damascus.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The video title says Iran has biological weapons, so the claim now has a named state, a location and a method.

mentions.claim_text: He says they were discussing Muslim prophetic words and looking for the sign of their savior, their Mahdi, that they have to do certain things, and that he heard them discussing bringing forth this false god.
mentions.quote: looking for the sign of their savior, their Mahdi
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an overheard private discussion, offered as the motive behind the attack.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the church has to rise up and pray like they never have because Jesus is coming for the bride, but that the Lord said he is coming back for a harvest and has long patience.
mentions.quote: I'm coming back for a harvest. I have long patience
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and long patience is the mechanism that lets an unfulfilled imminence continue indefinitely.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they are about to see Cuba liberated because God said he is bringing in a harvest and they have been oppressed and suppressed and cannot do what they need to do, and that God is about to liberate the people of Venezuela in a greater way.
mentions.quote: we're about to see Cuba liberated
mentions.falsify_match: Regime change or major liberalisation in Cuba and Venezuela.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. About to replaces the 2027 date the January telling carried, which loosens it.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is happening, that the Lord said he is cleaning his church because judgment begins in the house of the Lord first, and that they are seeing certain YouTubers exposing this darkness and calling people out where there is great corruption.
mentions.quote: there's certain YouTubers that are exposing this darkness
mentions.falsify_match: Ministry scandals surfacing.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He points at existing online exposure work as the fulfilment, which means the claim is matched to something already under way.

mentions.claim_text: He says he prays about it and asks whether he is seeing into the tribulation, and that the fact he starts having these visions and looking into tribulation when he prays tells them how close they are getting.
mentions.quote: Am I seeing into tribulation? That tells you how close we're getting
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and circular: the content of his visions is offered as evidence for the nearness the visions describe.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they are waiting on the word to activate those cells and that he sees it, prays that they never get the word and that the word giver is taken out, and calls for confusion in the camp concerning America and their cities.
mentions.quote: they're waiting on that word to activate those cells
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated activation of cells in American cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to the prayer. Take out the word giver is unusually direct language for a prayer target.

mentions.claim_text: He prays there will be no divided house in America, that they need peace and unity, that they continue to pray over the president and his safety, and over their churches concerning Ramadan being over next week.
mentions.quote: there'll be no divided house in America. We need peace and unity
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a prayer for unity in a country he elsewhere says is dividing.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a
